course.name: Miles High Club
course.tagline: A crypto alpha and research community led by analyst Miles Deutscher and a team of five other full-time analysts.
course.about: Miles High Club is a crypto trading and research community founded by Miles Deutscher, a crypto analyst with 5+ years of experience and 500,000+ social media followers. Launched in 2024, it combines a team of full-time analysts — covering institutional research, fundamentals and altcoins, low-timeframe trading, and airdrops — through a themed Discord server.

formats.label: Daily alpha & alerts
formats.description: Exclusive altcoin alpha, airdrop alerts and trade ideas.

formats.label: Private weekly livestreams
formats.description: Weekly livestreams and AMA sessions with Miles and the analyst team.

formats.label: Educational content
formats.description: 100+ hours of educational content and trading streams.

formats.label: Discord community
formats.description: A themed Discord server (Customs, Terminal, Kiosk, Lounge) with daily news/alert channels and voice chat.

pricing.name: Monthly
pricing.billing_note: Exclusive altcoin alpha, airdrop alerts and trade ideas, private weekly livestreams, 100+ hours of educational content, and full Discord access.

course.testimonials_note: We couldn't find any individually-quoted member testimonials for this community in the sources we could access, so none are shown here.

_notes.source: Built from the Whop community page itself (whop.com/miles-high-club), Whop's own blog review (whop.com/blog/miles-high-club-review) and WebSearch results for founder background. No separate dedicated website found outside Whop, so 'website' points to the Whop community page. Pricing, rating and commission confirmed via whoptrends.com and cross-checked against the Whop blog review (both agree on $199/month; the blog review additionally states $1,850/year). Annual pricing has no separate affiliate link provided, so it shares the one monthly link given — the same Whop checkout likely offers both billing options. No Trustpilot profile found (checked mileshighclub.com, 404). Logo cropped from the community's own Whop banner image (the paper-plane mark), since the only square avatar available was the founder's personal headshot photo rather than a brand mark.
